ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows a food web, in which deer, an animal similar to a wolf/coyote, a snake, a mouse, a bird, a butterfly, a grasshopper and other animals can be seen, as well as several plants drawn at the bottom and on the right side. Reasoning: In a food web, producers are organisms that can make their own food, usually green plants; animals belong to consumers. Therefore, the producers in the picture are plants.
